repo-cards.html.why: REGRESSION FIXTURE — ordinary copy beat us here. The converter wins links and boundaries for free, so this is parity work, not a differentiator. We must TIE at minimum; losing means a regression.

kanban-reordered.html.why: A converter walks the DOM, which here says Done / To Do / In Progress. It is confidently wrong, not merely vague. Still a genuine differentiator.

split-labels.html.why: A converter emits label text but cannot read live .value or selectedOptions, so the values simply are not there. Still a genuine differentiator.
